timing.description: One immutable completed minute of a piece of code in during.process; the reporter derives its eid from process, op, name, plugin and at. Rows merge by adding n, total, bucket and count values and taking the greatest max.

name.description: The measured code, never an entity id, query text, URL or value.

plugin.description: The emitting plugin; empty for work without plugin attribution.

at.description: The UTC completion minute, rounded down.

n.description: The number of completed spans and instants.

total.description: The sum of span durations in milliseconds.

max.description: The greatest span duration in milliseconds.

buckets.description: Fixed log-scale counts: exact zero, upper bounds 2^-10 through 2^30 milliseconds inclusive, then overflow. Read whole.

counts.description: The spans' summed numeric metrics, such as bundles, statements and rows; read whole.

commit.description: The process's commit sha, identifying the code measured.

trace.description: One selected operation with tracker context in during; its separately stored spans refer to this entity.

name.description: The root's code, never an entity id, query text, URL or value.

at.description: When the root began, in UTC.

span.description: One measured piece of code within a stored trace; each measurement is a separate component on this entity.

trace.description: The operation this span belongs to.

parent.description: The containing span; absent for the root.

name.description: The measured code, never a query, URL, credential or value.

package.description: The package owning the measured code.

elapsed.description: A span's start and duration in milliseconds relative to its trace root.

start.description: Milliseconds from the trace root start.

ms.description: Completed duration; absent for an unfinished span. Zero is meaningful for clocks that advance only across I/O.

rows_read.description: SQL cursor rows read during a span.

n.description: The measured count; parent spans include their descendants.

rows_written.description: SQL cursor rows written during a span.

n.description: The measured count; parent spans include their descendants.

statements.description: SQL statements executed during a span.

n.description: The measured count; parent spans include their descendants.
